title: Barbershop
description:
S1 E1
Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
description:
S1 E1 — Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
description:
S1 E1
It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

title: American Fiction
description:
S1 E1
Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

title: Love Jones
description:
S1 E1
In this sweet, comic romance set against the jazz rhythms of Chicago, two educated, upscale urban artists discover modern courtship as they both experience a Love Jones.

title: Guess Who
description:
S1 E1
When his daughter brings home her new fiancé, her uptight father discovers she's neglected to tell him three things: He's broke. He's unemployed. And he's white.

title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
description:
S1 E1
Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

title: Out of Time
description:
S1 E1
Denzel Washington stars in this spell-binding thriller as the Chief of Police of a small town who finds himself caught in the eye of a storm as he investigates the murder of a woman he was secretly seeing….because all the evidence points to him!
